title: Battle Royale World Border
description: Utility plugin that makes the World Border act like a Battle Royale game would. Highly configurable and available for UHC, survival games, and modded servers.
body:
# Battle Royale World Border

Turns Minecraft's world border into a round-based battle royale system, like Apex Legends, Pubg, Fortnite, etc. Instead of a static boundary or instant death outside the zone, the border will dynamically move just like a BR game, with pauses in between ("rounds"), giving servers a familiar BR pacing layer on top of vanilla world borders.

## Description

Designed for minigame hosts, survival games, UHC servers, etc, this plugin automates border control so admins can start a match with a single command and let the zone do the rest. It's also highly configurable with profiles you can define.

## Credits
